The numbers for "Emerald 10's" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
988.headline: How far along this game is

990.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "LADY LUCK", about a quarter are still unsold. The game is in the second half of its run, with two of four top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If you play "LADY LUCK" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
